summary: GRANSTUNET EIENDOM AS (org. no. 986 946 853) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-06-11. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 12.6 m and net income was NOK 707 930. Board chair: Helge Christian Haugen; auditor: BDO AS.
